limits: Spell and target choices are supplied. Native payment, effects, untap phasing and paid Disenchant validate rules paths, not autonomous strategy.
Bonesplitter attachment and Chrome Mox imprint are explicit legal preconditions; their attachment/ETB choices are not cast or chosen by these fixtures. The copied Mox pays for an actual green spell.
Historical/self imprints and the remembered-card case are explicit metadata contracts, not added printed Sol Ring or Grizzly Bears abilities.
The old native default direct-phasing assumption was corrected independently; both original baseline phases remain preserved in the gap report.
No phasing actions or rules events are emitted during restoration. Native phase-in and host-leave resolution are executed afterward in the fixtures.
